historyScope: Full repository migration inventory, not an observed database; Django auth/contenttypes prerequisites are supplied separately by the tests.
digestDefinition: operationsSha256 is SHA-256 of ast.get_source_segment for the exact operations list, brackets included. normalizedSha256 is AST dump after deleting only Migration.dependencies, preserving imports/helpers and other attributes. normalizedSha256: sha256 of a canonical AST text of the file with the Migration.dependencies assignment removed: node type and fields in order, with None and empty-list fields skipped, so the value is the same on every supported Python (ast.dump is not: 3.12 added fields and 3.13 omits empty ones).
